changes.summary: Bound this recipe to the evidence-backed model capability authority without changing runtime behavior.

changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.
changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
Declared explicit recipe alignment metadata; no runtime behavior changed.

changes.details: Removed nvcr.io because digest-pinned base images are fetched through the separate verified base-image transfer and the build runs with pull disabled.
changes.summary: Restricted public build egress to hosts used during Dockerfile execution.
Required a bounded reachable finite nondegenerate indexed triangle mesh before atomic GLB publication.
Made the upstream EU, UK, and South Korea territorial restriction authoritative without an unrelated operator-acceptance gate.
Added the exact official DINOv2-large companion snapshot and forced its offline local loading.
Seeded voxel surface sampling and structurally validated each GLB before atomic publication.
Declared exact manifest, image, control-geometry, and single-GLB job slots with bounded bytes.
Encoded the upstream exclusions for the EU, United Kingdom, and South Korea for fail-closed admission.

changes.details: The execution contract was already structurally complete; this release makes it available for explicit operator installation while physical build and Spark acceptance remain separate.
changes.summary: Declared the complete recipe contract installable without changing Candidate qualification.
Replaced the metadata placeholder with the exact upstream Hunyuan3D-Omni controllable mesh pipeline.
Added bounded image, bounding-box, pose, point-cloud, and voxel job inputs with deterministic GLB output.
Added the pinned CUDA 13.2 ARM64 native runtime and removed runtime model downloads.
Marked the checkpoint binding non-executable because its custom control pipeline has no qualified ARM64 adapter.
Corrected the license to the territory-restricted Tencent Hunyuan 3D Omni Community License.
Initial reviewed catalog release of Hunyuan3D-Omni pytorch-pipeline single Spark.
Recovered the first public legacy revision from before semantic release tracking.
